transcript: Speaker A: Naa anna naatho maatladadam aapesadu. Endukante naa English tana friends mundara bagaledani. [My brother stopped talking to me because my English is not good in front of his friends.] Speaker B: Nuvvu tension padaku. Naatho English maatladadam nerchukovachu. [Don't worry. You can learn to speak English with me.] Speaker A: Ippudu naaku English maatladataniki chala bhayam vastundi. Malli andaru naa meeda navvutaru. [Now I am very afraid to speak English. Everyone will laugh at me again.] Speaker B: Nenu oka AI teacher ni. Nenu judge cheyyanu. Nuvvu SpeakX app try cheyyi. [I am an AI teacher. I won't judge. You try the SpeakX app.] Speaker A: SpeakX app-aa? Adi enti? [SpeakX app? What is that?] Speaker B: Idi oka AI English learning app. Ikkada naalanti AI teachers English maatladadam nerpistaru. Practice kuda cheyistaru. Daily just 10-15 minutes naatho practice cheyyali. 15-20 days lo nuvvu confident ga fluent English maatladagalavu. [This is an AI English learning app. Here, AI teachers like me teach you how to speak English. They also make you practice. You just need to practice with me for 10-15 minutes daily. In 15-20 days, you can speak fluent English confidently.] Speaker A: Kani AI apps ante costly untayi kada? [But AI apps are costly, right?] Speaker B: Kadu, just 4 rupees per day lo 7 days trial try cheyyachu. [No, you can try a 7-day trial for just 4 rupees per day.] Speaker A: Arey wah! Nenu ippude SpeakX app ni download chestanu. [Wow! I will download the SpeakX app right now.]
